step1_analysis.description: A standard 3-transistor CMOS image sensor pixel. It consists of a reset transistor to initialize the photodiode, a source follower to buffer the photodiode voltage, and a row select transistor to connect the pixel to the column bus.

paper_reference.title: A Low-Power Low-Noise Ultrawide-Dynamic-Range CMOS Imager with Pixel-Parallel A/D Conversion

power_consumption.description: Power dissipation per pixel during the read operation.

sky130_expected.calculation: Power = VDD * I_col. With VDD=1.8V and a typical column bias of 1uA, power is 1.8uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The 40nW reported in the paper is for their custom PFM oscillator pixel. For this baseline 3T pixel, power is determined by the column bias current during the read phase.

sf_gain.description: Voltage gain of the source follower (dVOUT / dVPD).

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm / (gm + gmb). With body effect in SKY130, gmb is significant.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard source follower gain degradation due to the body effect since the bulk is tied to GND.

v_pd_reset.description: Maximum voltage reached at the photodiode node after reset.

sky130_expected.reasoning: The reset transistor (NMOS) passes a high voltage, so it suffers from a threshold voltage drop exacerbated by the body effect.

dynamic_range.description: Ratio of maximum signal swing to the noise floor.

sky130_expected.reasoning: The >100dB DR reported in the paper applies to their custom PFM architecture. A standard 3T pixel typically achieves around 60 dB.

fixed_pattern_noise.description: Variation in pixel output under uniform illumination due to mismatch.

sky130_expected.calculation: Mismatch in Vth of the source follower across pixels.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports 0.1% after correction. Uncorrected FPN for a 3T pixel in SKY130 is typically 1-2%.

step3_testbench.description: Transient simulation of a full pixel cycle (Reset, Integration, Read) to measure reset levels, source follower gain, and power consumption.
step3_testbench.spice:
* 3T APS Testbench
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* DUT
XM1 LABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_1 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 VDD N1 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 LABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_3 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}

* Voltage Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVRST LABEL_NET_0 0 1.8
* RST pulses high to reset the photodiode
VRST LABEL_NET_1 0 PULSE(0 1.8 1u 10n 10n 1u 20u)
* RS is kept high to continuously monitor the source follower output
VRS LABEL_NET_3 0 1.8

* Photodiode Model (Capacitance and Photocurrent)
C_pd N1 0 10f
I_photo N1 0 1n

* Column Bus Load
I_col LABEL_NET_2 0 1u
C_col LABEL_NET_2 0 100f

.control
  * Run transient analysis to simulate reset and integration
  tran 10n 15u
  
  * Measure Reset Levels
  meas tran v_pd_reset MAX v(N1) from=1u to=3u
  meas tran v_out_reset MAX v(LABEL_NET_2) from=1u to=3u
  
  * Measure Source Follower Gain during integration ramp
  * Point 1 (early integration)
  meas tran v_pd_1 find v(N1) at=3u
  meas tran v_out_1 find v(LABEL_NET_2) at=3u
  
  * Point 2 (mid integration)
  meas tran v_pd_2 find v(N1) at=6u
  meas tran v_out_2 find v(LABEL_NET_2) at=6u
  
  * Calculate Gain
  let sf_gain = (v_out_1 - v_out_2) / (v_pd_1 - v_pd_2)
  print sf_gain
  
  * Measure Power Consumption during read
  meas tran i_vdd_val find i(VVDD) at=5u
  let power = -i_vdd_val * 1.8
  print power
  
  quit
.endc
